Map indicators of extrapolation

Source: R/extrapolation.R
plot.RiskMap_extrapolation.Rd

Maps indicators returned by assess_extrapolation(), in the style of plot.RiskMap_prediction().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RiskMap_extrapolation'
plot(x, indicator = "extrapolation", ...)

Arguments

x

A RiskMap_extrapolation object.

indicator

Indicator to map: "extrapolation" (the default, the four classes), "spatial_unexplained", "covariate_novelty" or "covariate_leverage". Several indicators are arranged in two columns.

...

Not used.

Value

A ggplot object, to which further layers can be added. When several indicators are requested, a patchwork object combining one ggplot per indicator.
